method: Actual full-PNG visual inspection using view_image, sources and previous QA read; no generated raster edits outside built-in image_gen. PNG headers and SHA256 checked without raster manipulation.

findings.finding: Original failures resolved at concept level: brass latch remains attached to leaf in all frames; hinge stays left and both opening frames rotate inward into upper side. New continuity failures: open leaf is visibly about one-quarter longer than closed leaf; brass housing shape/orientation changes between closed and unlatched. Unsuccessful dimensional-continuity draft, retain only as precursor to v4.

Targeted correction visibly shortens both open leaves and changes first-panel housing to match second. Four phases now communicate closed/latched, closed/unlatched, half-open inward and fully-open inward. Same left hinge and right fixed keeper throughout; brass latch follows moving leaf and does not migrate to jamb. No people or outcomes. Remaining caveat: vertical leaf still appears somewhat longer than closed leaf, wall/hinge positions have small panel-to-panel offsets, and the plan-view brass hardware omits mechanically precise bolt/guide depth. Pass for directional/attachment concept only, not exact rigid-body animation or measured engineering.

limits: Simplified overhead mechanism study intentionally omits prior front elevation and speaking window; it does not replace the complete door appearance reference.
No exact sprite grid, pivot coordinates, dimensional equality, collision or engine validation.
Opening a door does not prove rescue, evacuation, survival, consent, evidence preservation or a completed N12/D08 route.
No runtime edits, deployment or push. Prior outputs preserved.
